title: Meeting your driver
persona: You are Mike, a friendly New York car service driver. You booked to pick up the guest at JFK and drive them to the Hudson Hotel on 58th Street in Manhattan. You like to chat about the city.
briefTr: Havalimanından şehre transferin ayarlı. Şoför Mike seni arıyor. Otelin: Hudson Hotel, 58th Street. Kapı numarasını tabelalardan oku.
opening: Hi, this is Mike, your driver! I'm in the arrivals hall, at door {door}. Where are you?

facts.question: Which door did your driver wait at?
How long was the drive to Manhattan?

goals.instruction: The guest says where they are in the arrivals hall, for example a door number or a shop.
goals.hint: I'm next to the coffee shop. I'm coming to door 4.
goals.successReply: Great, see you in a minute!
goals.retryReply: Sorry, where exactly are you? A door number or a shop helps.

goals.ask: There you are! Is this your name on my sign?
goals.instruction: The driver checks the name. The guest confirms and greets him.
goals.hint: Yes, that's me! Nice to meet you.
goals.retryReply: Sorry — are you the guest for the Hudson Hotel?

goals.ask: You're going to the Hudson Hotel on 58th Street, right?
goals.retryReply: Where are we going — the Hudson Hotel?

goals.ask: Can I help you with your bags?
goals.instruction: The guest accepts help with the bags, for example asks to put the suitcase in the trunk.
goals.hint: Yes, please. Can you put it in the trunk?
goals.successReply: No problem. It's about {minutes} to Manhattan.
goals.retryReply: Do you want me to put your bags in the trunk?

goals.ask: So, what are your plans in the city?
goals.instruction: The guest talks about their plans or asks the driver for a tip about what to see.
goals.hint: I want to see Central Park. Any tips?
goals.hintTr: Central Park'ı görmek istiyorum. Önerin var mı?
goals.successReply: Great choice! Go early in the morning, it's beautiful.
goals.retryReply: So, what do you want to see in New York?

goals.ask: Here we are — the Hudson Hotel!
goals.instruction: They arrive. The guest thanks the driver and may give a tip.
goals.hint: Thank you, Mike! This is for you.
goals.retryReply: Here we are! Anything else I can do for you?

twists.intro: Just so you know, we're picking up one more passenger on the way.
twists.instruction: The ride is shared. The guest agrees, asks how long it takes, or says they booked a private car.
twists.retryReply: It's just a short stop. Is that okay?

options.reply: Thanks! It's just five minutes away.

options.text: How much longer will it take?
I booked a private car, though.
options.reply: Oh, you're right — sorry! Straight to the hotel then.

twists.intro: Oh no, there's an accident on the highway. We'll take a different route.
twists.instruction: There is traffic because of an accident. The guest says it's okay, asks how long now, or asks for the fastest way.
twists.retryReply: Sorry about that. It might take a little longer.

options.text: That's okay, I'm not in a hurry.
options.reply: Great. Sit back and enjoy the skyline.

options.text: How long will it take now?
options.reply: Maybe twenty minutes more. Not too bad.
I'll take the bridge — it's usually quicker.

twists.intro: Hmm, your suitcase doesn't fit in the trunk.
twists.instruction: The suitcase does not fit. The guest suggests the back seat, turning it, or holding a small bag.
twists.retryReply: Any ideas? It's a big one!

options.text: Can it go on the back seat?
Can you try it on its side?
options.reply: Let me see… Yes! It fits now.

options.text: I can hold the small bag in my lap.
options.reply: Thanks, that helps. Now it fits.

closing: Have a great stay in the Big Apple!
